messages:
tam: Quick sync - need final acceptance criteria for BYOK + enterprise audit exports before we freeze the epic. Main open: escrow model, export verification, retention UI.

oliver: For SOC2 evidence we need a signed, verifiable bundle + metadata (who requested export, case id). Exports must verify offline.

maya: Infra note: full 7y full-text indexing is cost-prohibitive. Recommend tiered retention + an explicit rehydrate SLA for cold.

dawn: Ops: require runbook for key-revocation incidents and legal-hold fast-path. Also smoke tests for export integrity.

legal-bot: Legal: API must allow preservation-on-demand with reason, owner, and optional release_ts. We require export audit trail.

sec-bot: Security: detached signatures + manifest + tamper-hash stored in an append-only ledger. Key provenance must be recorded in manifest.

tam: Proposal (MVP): 1) tenant-scoped audit ingest and per-tenant export; 2) BYOK import + rotation notice + optional managed escrow; 3) retention tiers (hot 90d, warm 2y, cold remainder) with rehydrate SLA 24-72h; 4) legal-hold API; 5) signed export bundle (tar.gz + manifest + sig).

oliver: If customer revokes key, previously-signed bundles remain verifiable because sigs are detached. Need to document limitations for live re-encryption.

maya: Acceptance tests: signature validation, manifest completeness, legal-hold prevents deletion, rehydrate under SLA at 95pct, cost-estimator accuracy +-10%.

dawn: Owners: maya=infra/export, tam=product acceptance, oliver=KMS/escrow design, legal-bot=legal language, ops-bot=runbooks + smoke tests.

sec-bot: Recommend optional managed-escrow be HSM-backed with attestation logs. If not opted in, show clear recovery limitations in UI.

tam: UI requirement: retention slider + estimated monthly cost change and explicit warning when BYOK affects auto-rotate.

ops-bot: CI: compliance-smoke triggered for branch "feature/evidence-byo" -> https://ci.internal/1937772468 (logs).

tam: Next step: I'll sketch a one-pager with acceptance criteria and post by EOD. Schedule 30m review tomorrow to lock owners and signoff. :calendar:
